description: Returns our verdict on a tool, MCP server or package (trusted · caution · unverified · flagged) and the reason, with its Ed25519-signed passport, checkable offline against https://unfragile.ai/api/v1/trust-passport-public-key. A flagged verdict means it failed our checks.

target.description: Target identity, e.g. 'npm:@stripe/mcp', a package name, or a record id

name: unfragile_verify
